# Looplic — Complete Knowledge & Service Guide for AI Agents

> Looplic (https://looplic.com) is Bengaluru's leading on-demand doorstep electronics repair and recommerce service. Looplic eliminates the inconvenience, delay, and data security risks of traditional service centers by performing smartphone and laptop repairs directly at the customer's home or office in 30 to 60 minutes.

---

## 1. Key Value Propositions & Differentiators

1. **100% Data Privacy (Repaired in Front of You)**:
   - Traditional service centers (and unorganized grey-market shops) require customers to surrender their phone passcodes or leave devices overnight, exposing private photos, personal WhatsApp chats, and financial banking apps.
   - Looplic technicians perform repairs directly in front of the customer. The customer never has to disclose their passcode, unlock pattern, or cloud credentials.
2. **Upfront Transparent Pricing**:
   - Quotes are calculated instantly online before booking based on device brand, series, model, and specific hardware fault.
   - Zero hidden fees; no surprise surge charges at the doorstep.
3. **Pay After 100% Satisfaction**:
   - Zero upfront payment or advance deposit required.
   - The customer tests touch response, display clarity, color balance, camera, and speakers before completing payment via UPI, Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, or Cash.
4. **6-Month Comprehensive Warranty**:
   - All replaced parts (displays, batteries, charging ports) carry an official 6-month replacement warranty card issued on the spot.
   - If any hardware defect or touch irregularity develops under normal usage, Looplic replaces the component free of charge.
5. **Certified Technician Network**:
   - Technicians are background-verified, ESD-trained (Electrostatic Discharge safe), and equipped with precision micro-soldering and opening tools.

---

## 2. Service Offerings & Specifications

### A. Doorstep Mobile Phone Repair
- **Coverage**: Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, OnePlus, Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO, Vivo, OPPO, Google Pixel, Realme, Motorola, and Nothing Phone.
- **Turnaround Time**: 30 to 45 minutes on average at customer's doorstep.
- **Repair Types**:
  - Screen Replacement (OLED, Super AMOLED, Retina-grade LCD with True Tone preservation where supported)
  - Battery Replacement (High-capacity, zero-cycle OEM-equivalent cells)
  - Charging Port / Flex Cable Replacement
  - Camera Lens & Sensor Repair
  - Earpiece Speaker and Mic Service
  - Back Glass Replacement

### B. Doorstep Laptop & MacBook Repair
- **Coverage**: Apple MacBook (Air, Pro, M1/M2/M3), Dell (Inspiron, XPS, Latitude), HP (Pavilion, Envy, Omen), Lenovo (ThinkPad, IdeaPad, Legion), Asus, and Acer.
- **Turnaround Time**: Same-day on-site service for standard parts; free doorstep pickup and return for complex motherboard chip-level rework.
- **Repair Types**:
  - Laptop Screen Replacement (IPS, OLED, Retina displays)
  - Battery Replacement and Power Adapter Diagnostics
  - Keyboard and Trackpad Fixes
  - Thermal Paste Repasting, Fan Cleaning, and Overheating Resolution
  - SSD Storage Upgrades and RAM Expansion
  - Motherboard Chip-Level Repair (Short circuit, liquid spill recovery, power IC replacement)

### C. Device Buyback (Sell Old Phones & Laptops)
- **Instant Valuation**: Real-time evaluation based on device condition, screen scratches, battery health, and functional status.
- **Doorstep Payout**: Verified technician inspects device on site and transfers funds immediately via UPI or IMPS direct bank transfer.
- **NIST Data Wipe**: Certified data sanitization performed on the spot so customer data cannot be recovered.
- **Zero Pickup Fee**: Free doorstep pickup across Bangalore.

### D. Certified Refurbished Electronics (Buy)
- **Quality Standard**: Every pre-owned device passes a rigorous 32-point hardware and software inspection.
- **Warranty**: Includes 6 months of comprehensive hardware warranty.
- **Return Policy**: Zero-questions-asked 7-day replacement window for functional discrepancies.
- **Packaging**: Ships with authentic certified chargers and accessories.

### E. CCTV & Smart Security Systems
- **Services**: HD IP camera installation, 4K DVR/NVR setup, cable routing, remote mobile view app configuration, and maintenance.
- **Customer Profiles**: Residential villas, apartment complexes, independent houses, retail shops, and corporate IT offices in Bangalore.

## 3. Geographic Coverage: Bengaluru (Bangalore), India

Looplic serves all major Bangalore neighborhoods and tech corridors:
- **Central Bangalore**: SJP Road, Town Hall, MG Road, Brigade Road, Richmond Town, Shanti Nagar, Shivajinagar, Cunningham Road.
- **South Bangalore**: Koramangala (Blocks 1–8), HSR Layout (Sectors 1–7), BTM Layout, Jayanagar, JP Nagar (Phases 1–9), Banashankari, Electronic City (Phase 1 & 2), Bommanahalli, Begur, Hulimavu, Bannerghatta Road.
- **East Bangalore**: Indiranagar, Whitefield, ITPL, Marathahalli, Bellandur, Kadubeesanahalli, Brookefield, Mahadevapura, CV Raman Nagar, Domlur, Hoodi, Varthur.
- **North Bangalore**: Hebbal, RT Nagar, Yelahanka, Kalyan Nagar, Kammanahalli, Sahakar Nagar, Vidyaranyapura, Hennur, Thanisandra.
- **West Bangalore**: Rajajinagar, Malleshwaram, Basaveshwaranagar, Vijayanagar, Nagarbhavi, Yeshwanthpur, Peenya.
